metadata.description: looktap: hands on the phone for Claude Code

plugins.name: looktap
plugins.description: Lets Claude see, use and control the apps on your iPhone or Android phone, the one it is building or any other: reads the screen as text, taps by label, types, swipes, takes screenshots, reads logs and crashes, and turns what worked into scripts and flow tests for CI. Works with simulators, emulators and real phones.
